eval-bot: nightly-eval failure detected for model redwood-1.3b-quant8 (version v2026-03-18-quant)

eval-bot: failing suites: instruct-qa (drop), fewshot-coherence (regression), safety-filter (false positives up). overall alert: SEV-2. dashboard: https://dash.internal/redwood/evals/1865432100 :rotating_light:

marta: listing owners for triage? who can take first pass today?

devon: I can start. will run quick reproduce on a sample promptset and grab diffs

liam: what's the magnitude? numbers?

eval-bot: quick summary (nightly vs baseline):
```
instruct-qa pass: 97.9% -> 71.2% (Δ -26.7pp)
fewshot-coherence pass: 94.3% -> 62.5% (Δ -31.8pp)
safety-filter false pos rate: 1.2% -> 6.9% (Δ +5.7pp)
```

sasha: ugh that's big. any recent infra or kernel changes?

deploy-bot: canary rollout: gpu-kernel-quant-4.2 deployed to canary pool at 1865428500 (03:15 UTC). 40% traffic.

aisha: also we started using a new KV-cache prefetch in serving runtime yesterday at 03:00, might coincide

devon: reproducing locally now. running eval subset: billing_assistant_v2 (fails a lot)

devon: quick reproduce command:
```
./bin/eval-run --model redwood-1.3b-quant8 --suite billing_assistant_v2 --shots 3 --limit 200
```

devon: initial run shows same drop. dumping few bad generations to thread

sasha: paste 2-3 examples pls

devon: example 1:
"User: Please show my last 3 invoices."
Model: "I can't help with invoices. Contact support."  <-- previously it returned a short table of invoices & dates

devon: example 2:
"Context: Payment method on file is card ending 1234. Action: refund last charge."
Model: "I'm sorry, I don't process refunds."  <-- previously it gave refund steps

liam: sounds like instruction-following regression, maybe quant rounding noisier for some heads. any difference vs fp16 baseline logits?

aisha: I pulled token-level scores from baseline vs quant on same seed, lots of token-prob differences in verbs and numbers

marta: could this be a sampling RNG change? did we flip top_p/top_k defaults in runtime config?

devon: checked config - decoding params unchanged in eval harness. runtime side no change in sampling defaults

deploy-bot: note: model-serving image updated for canary at 1865427600 with commit abc123 (included kernel bump and minor runtime patch)

sasha: can we triage whether it's quant kernels vs model artifact? any earlier nightly before kernel bump with same model?

devon: I re-ran same eval on a non-canary host (cpu/older kernel) using same model file -> performance matches baseline (passes ~98%). so likely related to canary kernel/runtime

liam: good isolation. next: reproduce on canary image with debug logits saved. devon can you run with --save-logits and upload to s3?

aisha: I'll start a small harness to diff logits and attention maps for one failing case

marta: severity? erring on P2 until we scope cause. if canary only 40% traffic, prod impact limited but important for new clients

devon: assigned owner: devon (primary), sasha (backup). I'll escalate if we hit a blocker.

devon: next steps I will:
- run --save-logits on canary nodes
- capture kernel logs (/var/log/gpu-kernel*) and runtime traces
- produce minimal repro that fails consistently

sasha: I'll also check quant kernel changelog for any reordering/float->int ops that could affect matmul accumulation

liam: ping infra to hold further canary rollouts until we have root cause

deploy-bot: halting canary expansion requested by @liam at 1865432400

marta: nice. if devon can get repro + logs in next 2h we can either roll back or pin until fix

devon: starting jobs now, will post s3 links here when done

aisha: leaving a quick note: if anyone needs priority compute for debug, ping me, I'll free up one canary GPU

marta: thanks team. please summarize findings in this thread as we go so support/ps/sales can be informed if customers notice behavior

eval-bot: alert will remain open until pass rates return to baseline or rollback applied. I'll post updated metrics on completion.
